text.autoconfig.hyrule_terrors.option.ma: Enable Master Sword
Turns the Master Sword awakening system on or off.
Awaken in Nether or End
The Master Sword awakens while the player is in the Nether or The End.
Awaken Near Sculk
The Master Sword awakens when sculk blocks are detected nearby.
Awaken Near Bosses
The Master Sword awakens when near boss-like mobs (Warden, Wither, Ender Dragon).
Awaken Near Evil Mobs
The Master Sword awakens when mobs in the hyrule_terrors:evil_mobs tag are nearby.
Awaken Check Radius
How far the Master Sword checks for bosses or evil mobs.
Sculk Scan Radius
How far the Master Sword checks for sculk blocks.
Awaken Check Interval (Ticks)
How often the Master Sword checks awakening conditions. 20 ticks = 1 second.
Bonus Damage vs Evil
Extra damage dealt to bosses and mobs considered evil while awakened.
Knockback Resistance Bonus
Extra knockback resistance granted while holding the awakened Master Sword.
Extra Boss Entity IDs
Additional entity IDs that should count as bosses (example: "minecraft:elder_guardian").
